title: Glowing glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='lensGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fe8ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d7bff' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bff6ff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5fd0ff' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2fa8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura behind glasses -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='46' ry='26' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- left lens -->
  <rect x='10' y='34' width='34' height='32' rx='10' ry='10' fill='url(#lensGrad)' stroke='#aef4ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- right lens -->
  <rect x='56' y='34' width='34' height='32' rx='10' ry='10' fill='url(#lensGrad)' stroke='#aef4ff' stroke-width='3'/>

  <!-- lens highlights -->
  <path d='M17 42 Q22 39 27 42' stroke='#e8fdff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 42 Q68 39 73 42' stroke='#e8fdff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 42 56 48' stroke='#aef4ff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- temples / arms -->
  <path d='M10 47 Q4 47 2 51' stroke='#aef4ff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M90 47 Q96 47 98 51' stroke='#aef4ff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='70' r='2' fill='#d8faff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='2' fill='#d8faff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#d8faff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='1.5' fill='#d8faff'/>
</svg>
